connection_condition: every district row carries the name of the region that contains it, so one region groups several districts
description: A region is composed of its districts; a district belongs to exactly one containing region.

connection_condition: the owner role is one of the two values of the disposition role that distinguish holders
description: An account owner is a kind of account holder; the owner role is a subset of the holder roles.

connection_condition: the disponent role is the other value of the disposition role that distinguishes holders
description: A disponent is a kind of account holder; the disponent role is a subset of the holder roles.

connection_condition: a disposition references the account it belongs to
description: An account is composed of its dispositions; a disposition cannot exist without its account.

connection_condition: a disposition references the client it belongs to
description: A client is composed of the dispositions recording their account roles; a disposition cannot exist without its client.

connection_condition: a card references the disposition it was issued against
description: A card is issued against a disposition and cannot exist without it; in this data every card hangs off an owner disposition.

connection_condition: a loan contract references the account it is granted on
description: An account is composed of its loan contracts; a loan contract cannot exist without its account.

connection_condition: a transaction references the account on which the movement occurred
description: An account is composed of its transactions; a transaction cannot exist without its account.

connection_condition: a standing order references the account it debits
description: An account is composed of its standing orders; a standing order cannot exist without its account.

connection_condition: a client references the district in which the client lives
description: A district groups the clients residing in it; this district reference is the residence of the client and is recorded independently of the district of the client's accounts.

connection_condition: an account references the district in which its branch is located
description: A district groups the accounts held at the branch located in it; this district reference is the branch location, distinct from the residence district of the client.

connection_condition: the running-contract codes are a subset of the loan contract status value domain
description: A running contract is one of the possible contract states; the running states are a subset of all contract states.

connection_condition: the card withdrawal is one of the codes of the transaction operation dimension
description: A credit card withdrawal is a kind of transaction operation; its code is a subset of the operation value domain.

connection_condition: indirect: a contract references an account, and each account has exactly one owner disposition, so the owner is the client standing behind the contract
description: Ownership of an account is the condition under which a client is treated as holding that account's contracts; the connection is indirect because contracts reference accounts rather than clients.

connection_condition: indirect: a card references a disposition, and every card in the data hangs off an owner disposition
description: Cards are held by account owners; the connection is indirect because cards reference dispositions rather than clients.

connection_condition: age is computed from the birth date relative to a reference date fixed by the analysis
description: Client age is derived from the birth date; because no age column exists, the reference date must be fixed explicitly by the analysis.

connection_condition: the share is the count of clients of one gender divided by the count of all clients in the same population
description: Gender proportion is derived from client gender counts taken over a defined client population.

connection_condition: the increment is the relative change of the later rate against the 1995 rate as the baseline denominator
description: The unemployment rate increment uses the 1995 rate as its baseline value.

connection_condition: the increment is the relative change of the later rate against the 1995 rate as the baseline denominator
description: The unemployment rate increment uses the 1996 rate as the later value being compared against the baseline.

connection_condition: the gap is the difference between the highest and the lowest salary level among the districts being compared
description: The average salary gap is derived from the district average salary levels once the comparison set is fixed.
